<TD WIDTH="12%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>Item&nbsp;8.01.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><B>Other Events. </B></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On June 8, 2018, Aleris International, Inc. (the &#147;Company&#148;), the direct wholly
owned subsidiary of Aleris Corporation, issued a press release announcing that it priced a private offering of $400 million aggregate principal amount of 10.750% senior secured junior priority notes due 2023 (the &#147;Notes&#148;) at par. The
offering is expected to close on June 25, 2018, subject to customary closing conditions. The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the sale of the Notes, together with the proceeds of a proposed new senior secured first lien term loan and
cash on hand, to (i)&nbsp;redeem all of its currently outstanding 7.875% Senior Notes due 2020 and 9.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2021, (ii) repay a portion of its outstanding borrowings under its existing asset-based revolving credit facility and
(iii)&nbsp;pay related fees and expenses. A copy of the press release announcing the Company&#146;s pricing of the Notes is set forth as Exhibit 99.1 hereto and is incorporated by reference herein. </P>

</TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ALERIS INTERNATIONAL, INC. ANNOUNCES PRICING OF </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SENIOR SECURED JUNIOR PRIORITY NOTES OFFERING </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">CLEVELAND, OH &#150; June 8, 2018 &#150; In connection with its previously announced debt refinancing transaction, Aleris International, Inc. (the
&#147;Company&#148;), the direct wholly owned subsidiary of Aleris Corporation (&#147;Aleris&#148;), today announced that it priced a private offering of $400 million aggregate principal amount of 10.750% senior secured junior priority notes due
2023 (the &#147;Notes&#148;) at par. The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the sale of the Notes, together with the proceeds of a proposed new senior secured first lien term loan (the &#147;New First Lien Term Loan Facility&#148;) and
cash on hand, to (i)&nbsp;redeem all of its currently outstanding 7.875% Senior Notes due 2020 and 9.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2021 (collectively, the &#147;Existing Senior Notes&#148;), (ii) repay a portion of its outstanding borrowings under
its existing asset-based revolving credit facility (the &#147;ABL Facility&#148;) and (iii)&nbsp;pay related fees and expenses. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The offering is expected
to close on June 25, 2018, subject to customary closing conditions. The closing of the offering of Notes is expected to occur substantially concurrently with, and is conditioned upon, the Company&#146;s entry into the New First Lien Term Loan
Facility and a proposed amendment to the ABL Facility. The consummation of the debt refinancing transaction is subject to a number of factors, and we cannot assure you that we will consummate the debt refinancing transaction, including the closing
of the offering of Notes, on the terms described, on favorable terms or at all. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Notes will be guaranteed by Aleris and certain of the Company&#146;s
subsidiaries. The Notes and the guarantees will be secured by (i)&nbsp;a second-priority lien on substantially all of the Company&#146;s and the guarantors&#146; assets (other than the ABL Collateral (as defined below)) including, without
limitation, all owned and material U.S. real property, equipment, intellectual property and stock of the Company and the guarantors (other than Aleris) and other subsidiaries (including 100% of the outstanding non - voting stock (if any) and 65% of
the outstanding voting stock of certain &#147;first tier&#148; foreign subsidiaries and certain &#147;first tier&#148; foreign subsidiary holding companies), which assets will secure the New First Lien Term Loan Facility on a first priority basis
and (ii)&nbsp;a third-priority lien on all of the Company&#146;s and the guarantors&#146; (other than Aleris) inventory, accounts receivable, deposit accounts and related assets (subject to certain exceptions), which assets secure the ABL Facility
on a first priority basis and will secure the New First Lien Term Loan Facility on a second priority basis (the &#147;ABL Collateral&#148;), in each case excluding certain assets and subject to permitted liens. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Notes will be offered in a private offering exempt from the registration requirements of the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the
&#147;Securities Act&#148;). The Notes will be offered and sold only to persons reasonably believed to be qualified institutional buyers pursuant to Rule 144A and to certain persons outside the United States pursuant to Regulation S, each under the
Securities Act. </P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Notes have not been and will not be registered under the Securities Act and may not be offered or sold in the
United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from, or in a transaction not subject to, the registration requirements of the Securities Act and other applicable securities laws. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This press release is for informational purposes only and is not an offer to sell nor the solicitation of an offer to purchase securities and shall not
constitute an offer, solicitation or sale in any state or jurisdiction in which, or to any person to whom such an offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful. Any offer of the Notes will be made only by means of a private offering memorandum. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This press release does not constitute a notice of redemption under the Existing Senior Notes indentures, or an offer to tender for, or purchase, any of the
Existing Senior Notes or any other security. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>About Aleris </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Aleris is a privately held, global leader in aluminum rolled products production. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, Aleris operates 13 production facilities in
North America, Europe and Asia. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>Forward-Looking Statements </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Certain statements contained in this press release are &#147;forward-looking statements&#148; within the meaning of the federal securities laws. Statements
about our beliefs and expectations and statements containing the words &#147;may,&#148; &#147;could,&#148; &#147;would,&#148; &#147;should,&#148; &#147;will,&#148; &#147;believe,&#148; &#147;expect,&#148; &#147;anticipate,&#148; &#147;plan,&#148;

borrowings under the New First Lien Term Loan Facility. In addition, forward-looking statements include statements about, among other things, future costs and prices of commodities, production volumes, industry trends, anticipated cost savings,
anticipated benefits from new products, facilities, acquisitions or divestitures, projected results of operations, achievement of production efficiencies, capacity expansions, future prices and demand for our products and estimated cash flows and

material adverse changes in the aluminum industry or our <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">end-uses,</FONT> such as global and regional supply and demand conditions for aluminum and aluminum products, and changes in our customers&#146; industries;
(4)&nbsp;increases in the cost, or limited availability, of raw materials and energy; (5)&nbsp;our ability to enter into effective metal, energy and other commodity derivatives or arrangements with customers to manage effectively our exposure to
